newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht lower late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht lower late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate closed steady at its Thursday morning range of 11.50-12.00 percent as late dollar buying sustained demand for baht funds, dealers said.
"An expected further fall of interbank rates today was stopped by dollar buying in the afternoon," said a dealer at a foreign bank.

The baht eased to 25.454-25.459 to the dollar near the close from 25.447-25.450 in early morning as a stronger dollar against other major currencies triggered buying of the U.S. unit here, dealers said.
"Some banks also closed dollar positions early, well ahead of the general election. The trade is expected to be sluggish tomorrow," said a currency dealer.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was quoted at 8.50/9.50 satangs per dollar late on Thursday against 8.75/9.75 in early morning.
The dollar/baht mid-rate was fixed at 25.43, unchanged from Wednesday.
